title: CALMA: A Process for Deriving Context-aligned Axes for Language Model Alignment
findings: In a pilot study to derive context-specific alignment axes, participants from India identified 'religious bias' as a key concern for a history-focused educational assistant. This contrasted with the MIT student group, which focused more on other types of bias (e.g., slavery, Indigenous narratives), demonstrating that the perceived importance of religious bias as an alignment axis is context-dependent.
